summary: In {design}, the document that explains the scene looks like an ordinary book.
realLife: Reviewing the Forgotten Heroes medal, John Saunders asked for a more recognizable passport on the back, and the member sponsoring the design accepted the change.
gates: A design uses a passport to distinguish the scene and the board can request revisions.
inGame: needs: passport image and requested revision.

turns.what: A crest makes the passport recognizable.
turns.pulledBy: The engraving holds the small cover detail.
turns.writesBack: The revised passport goes on the next proof.

turns.what: The identifying mark disappears at actual size.
turns.pulledBy: A reduced proof loses the cover detail.
turns.writesBack: Members ask for a different way to identify the document.
